decision: scripts/ci-local-e2e.sh reproduces the CI e2e job locally with a throwaway docker run Postgres on an ephemeral loopback port and next start alone on 127.0.0.1:4210 with HOST=0.0.0.0 in its environment
rationale: The job went red on feat/agentview for conditions no local run exercised (production mode, DAAX_TRUST_LOCAL_OPERATOR=1, fresh Postgres, AGENTVIEW_DAEMON_URL on 7793). The job database is a fresh service container per run; a docker run of the same image with a generated password is the faithful analogue and never touches the operator database. HOST=0.0.0.0 is what lib/auth-trust reads for posture; next start binds from -H only, so the posture matches CI while the socket stays on loopback
alternatives: docker compose up -d postgres (rejected: the compose service is the operator persistent dev database on 5432 with a named volume and fixed container name, so a generated password would recreate the running container or fail to authenticate); starting the terminal server on a second port (rejected: the browser derives the terminal WebSocket as <page hostname>:4201 so the browser-driven terminal specs cannot be redirected; 4201 is held by bun dev); binding 0.0.0.0 as the job does (rejected: exposes a trust-everyone instance on the tailnet)
